Someone had waited long enough.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有完全睡着。路灯将湿漉漉的柏油路染成橙黄色，出租车孤独地滑过十字路口，车轮碾过积水，溅起细碎的光。便利店的玻璃门半开着，收银员趴在柜台上打盹，日光灯嗡嗡作响。远处环卫车缓缓移动，橙色警示灯一闪一闪，像城市迟钝的心跳。楼道里偶尔传来婴儿啼哭，很快又归于寂静。天空是深蓝与灰黑之间一种说不清的颜色，既非夜晚，也非清晨。这个时刻属于失眠者、赶路人和那些还没想好明天的人。城市呼吸着，等待第一缕光。", "w03": "• Recursion means a function calls itself to solve a smaller piece of the same problem — like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you have to look up.\n• Each time it calls itself, the problem gets a little simpler, until you reach an easy case (called the base case) that you can answer immediately without calling yourself again.\n• Then all those calls finish in reverse order, like stacked boxes being unpacked one by one, until you have the final answer."}
